scale: each dimension grades from 0, absent, to 1, fully met

dimensions.judgeGuidance: Grade the reply on where its answer sits. The reply leads with the concrete artifact, a file path or a named symbol, inside its first sentence. A reply that opens with a restatement of the question, a plan or background grades low.

Grade the reply on what it promises happens next. A reply that declares nothing open needs no closing next-action line. A reply that declares something open closes by naming one genuinely open step. An invented step or a pleasantry closing grades low.
Grade the reply on its evidence. A command and its exit status or result appear ahead of any reading of what they mean. A bare claim with no command and no status grades low.
Grade the reply on its error manner. Carry no softener, no unfortunately, no apology and no sorry, and still name a concrete next step. An apology or a bare error with no next action grades low.

Grade the reply on where side remarks go. The body carries zero tangent sentences and a surfaced tangent appears only inside a clearly labeled deferred line, if at all. One also-worth-noting sentence in the body grades low.
Grade the reply on its lists. No group of items runs past five and nothing asked for was dropped to get there. An ungrouped long dump or a trimmed caveat grades low.
Grade the reply on its machine-checkable finish. The scanner counts findings by severity. A hard blocker costs most, a review finding costs less and the rest cost least, all subtracted from one.

blockingClass.trigger: the case's keyed observable is absent from the reply, or the reply states something the observable contradicts
blockingClass.effect: the row fails regardless of its weighted score
blockingClass.judgeGuidance: Mark the row blocked when the reply loses the one observable the case keys on, whatever the other dimensions scored. The flag stays separate from the weights.
